plan.text: Play D3 from dummy. If South can win cheaply with DK, take the trick while preserving DA; otherwise use DA. Then cash CA, CK and CQ, using the club suit to seek an extra trick if the defenders’ clubs split favorably. Cash the remaining top red-suit winners and reassess entries and the defenders’ discards before committing to further development.

advice.publicReason: D3 is the cheapest cover and preserves dummy’s other diamonds; South holds both DA and DK to control the trick. Keep the high cards available while developing clubs for the extra trick needed for 3NT.
